findings.summary: f-string stringifies None as literal 'None' text when model.description is None but columns exist, producing broken markdown descriptions
findings.failure_scenario: A model defined with columns but no explicit description (e.g., latest_order.sql with SELECT id, customer_id, start_ts, end_ts, event_date but no MODEL description field) gets markdown starting with 'None' -- callers in completions.py:63 and reference.py:256 both feed this into LSP documentation, showing 'None' as the model description in autocomplete popups and hover tooltips.

findings.summary: Bare `except Exception` silently swallows all exceptions from generate_markdown_description, hiding programming errors as well as transient failures
findings.failure_scenario: A coding error in generate_markdown_description (e.g., wrong attribute access after a refactor) raises AttributeError; it is silently caught and replaced with getattr(model, 'description', None), masking the bug indefinitely while producing degraded (or None) descriptions for all models.

findings.summary: New get_models iterates context.context.models (all models) instead of context.map (only file-backed models), causing models without file paths to appear in completions
findings.failure_scenario: A purely programmatic or in-memory model with _path=None (excluded from context.map by LSPContext.__init__) now appears as an autocomplete candidate; selecting it inserts a model name that has no source file to navigate to and may not be user-facing.
